# RBI approves Fincare Small Finance Bank Ltd. – AU Small Finance Bank Ltd. Amalgamation

March 04, 2024 **RBI approves Fincare Small Finance Bank Ltd. – AU Small Finance Bank Ltd.** **Amalgamation** The Reserve Bank of India has sanctioned the Scheme of Amalgamation of Fincare Small Finance Bank Ltd. (Transferor Bank) with AU Small Finance Bank Ltd. (Transferee Bank). The Scheme has been sanctioned in exercise of the powers contained in sub-section (4) of Section 44A of the Banking Regulation Act, 1949. The effective date of the amalgamation shall be April 01, 2024. All the branches of Fincare Small Finance Bank Ltd. will function as branches of AU Small Finance Bank Ltd. with effect from April 01, 2024.

## (Yogesh Dayal)
